FEATURES.f1_desc: We personally match your profile to employers who hold a valid sponsor licence across Europe, UK, Canada and Australia.
FEATURES.f2_desc: Our team builds your professional profile and creates your CV in the correct format for your target country — whether it is Europe, UK, Canada, Australia, Gulf or Asia.
FEATURES.f3_desc: We guide you through every step — documents needed, visa process, interview preparation — in Tamil and English.
FEATURES.f4_desc: Every candidate on our platform has been personally verified by our team. No fake profiles, no time wasting.
FEATURES.f5_desc: Filter by nationality, sector, experience, target country, English level and more to find exactly the right candidate.
FEATURES.f6_desc: Found the right candidate? Our team personally facilitates the introduction — professional, smooth, and verified.

WHY.w1_desc: Not a public job board. Every candidate and recruiter is personally approved by our admin team before getting access.
WHY.w2_title: We Do The Work For You
WHY.w2_desc: You don't apply blindly to hundreds of jobs. Our team personally matches and forwards your profile to the right employer.
WHY.w3_desc: We only work with employers who hold a valid sponsor licence. Every opportunity on our platform is real, legal, and verified.

STEPS.candidate1_desc: Admins create your profile and grant you access to the platform. Our team will contact you within 24 hours to begin your onboarding.
STEPS.candidate2_desc: Our team personally reviews your background, builds your professional profile, and matches you to visa-sponsored employers in your chosen country.
STEPS.candidate3_desc: We forward your profile directly to matched employers, arrange the interview introduction, and guide you through the visa process step by step.
STEPS.recruiter1_desc: Admins create your recruiter profile and grant you access to the talent pool immediately.
STEPS.recruiter2_desc: Use powerful filters to find candidates that match your requirements. Save the best to your shortlist.
STEPS.recruiter3_desc: Request contact info for your top candidates. Once approved, reach out directly and make the hire.

TESTIMONIALS.t1_quote: NTL Career Nexus made finding the right frontend role incredibly simple. Within two weeks I had three interview requests from companies I genuinely wanted to work for.
TESTIMONIALS.t1_role: Frontend Developer, Hired via NTL Career Nexus
TESTIMONIALS.t2_quote: The contact-request system is brilliant. Candidates feel safe and I get verified access without any friction. Best hiring tool we've used this year.
TESTIMONIALS.t3_quote: I was skeptical about yet another jobs platform, but NTL Career Nexus's profile system is genuinely detailed. Recruiters could see my full skill set without a back-and-forth.
TESTIMONIALS.t4_quote: Managing our hiring pipeline through NTL Career Nexus has cut our time-to-hire in half. The shortlist and contact workflow is exactly what we needed.

COOKIE_CONSENT.title: We use cookies
COOKIE_CONSENT.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, and improve your experience. Essential and authentication cookies are always active — they are required for the application to work. You can customise which optional cookies you allow.

COOKIE_PREFERENCES.title: Cookie Preferences
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.subtitle: Manage how this application uses cookies and local storage on your device.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.essential_desc: Required for the application to function. Includes CSRF protection, secure routing, and core session management.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.essential_examples: Internal routing state. No personally identifiable data.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.authentication_desc: Keeps you signed in across page loads. The refresh token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie (server-managed, inaccessible to JavaScript). The access token is held in localStorage and expires automatically.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.authentication_examples: HttpOnly refresh token cookie (7-day expiry, Secure + SameSite=Strict in production). Access token in localStorage (2-hour expiry).
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.analytics_desc: Analytics cookies help website owners understand how visitors interact with websites by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.analytics_examples: Page views, feature usage, error rates. No personally identifiable data.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.marketing_desc: Marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and engaging for the individual user.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.marketing_examples: Ad personalisation, conversion tracking. Not currently in use.
COOKIE_PREFERENCES.preferences_note: Your preferences are stored locally on your device and will be remembered for 12 months. You can update them at any time from the Manage Cookies link in the page footer.
